messages:
Lee (eng-sre): seeing a spike of apiserver 503s in eu-west-2 + controller-manager restarts. GPU onboard queue is ballooning, new pods stuck Pending. anyone else?
Anika (oncall): yep, saw that ~30m ago. watch backlog climbing, etcd compaction lagging. quick grep shows repeated `watch_cache: failed to dispatch` errors.
Maria (sre): also seeing slow etcd commits:
```
2026-03-22T09:41:12Z etcdserver: apply snapshot slow, took 1.8s
2026-03-22T09:41:13Z etcdserver: txn failed: i/o timeout
```
Suspect NVMe iops ~saturated in eu-west edge.
Sam (infra): we have an egress rate-limit rolling in eu-west (cost cap) — provisioner retries are getting throttled by our outbound queue. I paused the limiter for the provisioner service a minute ago.
Lee (eng-sre): nice, any change after pause?
Sam (infra): small improvement; apiserver 503s dropping from ~120/min -> ~40/min but controller-manager leader flips still happening. provisioner still backing off on GPU attach attempts.
Jordan (cs): this is hitting a few Dedicated customers creating new clusters — CS getting messages. Can we provide ETA for mitigation?
Anika (oncall): temporary mitigation plan: 1) route GPU onboarding traffic to us-west fallback pool (cheap but higher latency) 2) increase kube-apiserver `--max-requests-inflight` and `--default-not-ready-toleration` for controller-manager to reduce leader churn 3) schedule an etcd compaction and check NVMe tail latency.
Maria (sre): adding commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/controller-manager
kubectl -n kube-system exec -it etcd-0 -- sh -c 'ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl defrag'
iostat -x 1 5  # showed 95% util on nvme0n1
```
Sam (infra): I bumped provisioner burst to allow 20 concurrent attach attempts and routed onboarding to us-west for new requests. keeping an eye on billing spike.
Lee (eng-sre): thanks. I'll watch leader-election metrics and keep controller-manager restarts at bay. if leader flips stop within 10m we can avoid customer notices.
ops-bot: incident created INC-3421 and page sent to oncall escalation.
Jordan (cs): please DM me when stabilized so I can update affected customers. :+1:
Maria (sre): quick followup: we should discuss longer-term: increase NVMe capacity for eu-west or move heavy onboarding to burst pools. cost vs reliability tradeoff to bring to infra sync tomorrow.
Lee (eng-sre): agreed — will bring to postmortem if we don't fully stabilize in next 2 hours. thanks all for fast responses.
